fr.recommendations: • No significant responder access or movement concerns are visible from the available imagery.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim tree branches that hang over or directly touch the structure.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to increase open space between them.
• Remove shrubs growing directly against the walls of the structure.
• Separate shrubs from nearby trees so fire cannot move easily between them.
• Cut back shrubs to increase open ground between individual plants.
• Keep grass and low vegetation mowed short in the open areas immediately around the structure.
• Clear any dead leaves, branches, or plant debris from the ground next to the structure.
• Keep all access routes free of overhanging branches that could block a vehicle.
• Mark the driveway entrance clearly so it is easy to find under poor visibility conditions.
